question.text:
Please select the best analysis of emotion for someone appearing in the image:

A. A sudden overwhelming shock triggers disbelief and panic as the mind races to comprehend an unforeseen danger while the body instinctively reacts with frozen tension and a surge of urgency
B. A sudden surge of astonishment triggers heightened awareness and mental engagement as the mind scrambles to process unexpected input while curiosity and intrigue take hold
C. A sudden overwhelming shock grips the mind as disbelief floods in and thoughts race to comprehend an unforeseen event that disrupts the expected flow of reality
D. A wave of surprise floods through with a mix of excitement and apprehension as the mind races with uncertainty and anticipation about what lies ahead

Please provide the option letter of the most possible answer.

data.true_answer: A sudden overwhelming shock triggers disbelief and panic as the mind races to comprehend an unforeseen danger while the body instinctively reacts with frozen tension and a surge of urgency
